name: VoxCeleb Speaker Recognition Challenge 2023
description: This paper describes the DKU-MSXF submission to track 4 of the VoxCeleb Speaker Recognition Challenge 2023 (VoxSRC-23). Our system pipeline contains voice activity detection, clustering-based diarization, overlapped speech detection, and target-speaker voice activity detection, where each procedure has a fused output from 3 sub-models. Finally, we fuse different clustering-based and TSVAD-based diarization systems using DOVER-Lap and achieve the 4.30% diarization error rate (DER), which ranks first place on track 4 of the challenge leaderboard.
reputation: VoxSRC is a well-known annual speaker recognition challenge with strong community participation and widely reported leaderboard results.
notes: Challenge-style benchmark with a relatively small held-out evaluation set; results are highly system-dependent and not directly comparable across tracks.
